title: Yellowed Japanese Pork Shoyu Ramen
description: A bitter and crumbly Japanese dish featuring ground cumin and miso-marinate, served in a paella pan as a ramen-shoyu style meal.
instructions: Heat the paella pan over medium-high heat and cook the ground pork until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste, ground cumin, and shoyu sauce, then add the mixture to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth to the pan and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir to combine with the pork and broth mixture.
Season with soy sauce to taste, then garnish with green onions and serve.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
